run_asyncio_route_guide_client: run the asyncio gRPC route guide client demo connecting to localhost:50051
review_guide_get_one_feature: review the guide_get_one_feature function that performs a unary gRPC call to fetch a feature
review_guide_list_features: review the guide_list_features function that performs a server-streaming gRPC call to list features in a rectangle
review_guide_record_route: review the guide_record_route function that performs a client-streaming gRPC call to record a route
review_guide_route_chat: review the guide_route_chat function that performs a bidi-streaming gRPC call for route chat
